text: Users can generate an API key from account settings for self-serve API access
quote: Head to the API Access section of your User Settings and generate an API key.

text: API lets you list the most recent meetings recorded or shared with your team
quote: List the 10 most recent meetings recorded by you or shared to your team.

text: You can set up a webhook to receive meeting events
quote: Set up a webhook for your meetings.

text: Official TypeScript and Python SDKs are available for building integrations
quote: Use our Typescript or Python SDK.

text: Developers can build a public OAuth app so other Fathom users can install it
quote: Building a **public OAuth app** (for other Fathom users to install)? [Start here](/oauth) instead.

text: SDK provides a verify_webhook helper to validate webhook signatures
quote: you can use the `verify_webhook` helper

text: REST API is authenticated via API keys generated in account settings
quote: All REST API resources are authenticated with API keys generated via the Fathom website's settings area.

text: API includes an endpoint to download meeting recordings
quote: Added download recording endpoint.

text: API includes a users and permissions endpoint for admin management
quote: Added users and permissions endpoint.

text: Official MCP server lets AI assistants like ChatGPT and Claude query meeting data
quote: Fathom now offers an official MCP (Model Context Protocol) server, allowing you to connect your Fathom meeting data to AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and more.

text: Fathom is available as an official connector inside Claude
quote: Fathom is available as an **official connector** in Claude

text: CRM field sync automatically updates records after meetings
quote: CRM field sync, updating records after meetings automatically

text: Deal View feature summarizes CRM-related meeting insights
quote: Deal View summarizing insights

text: Coaching metrics and AI scorecards analyze call performance
quote: Coaching metrics & AI scorecards

text: Users can build playlists of highlight clips from meetings
quote: Playlists of highlights from meetings

text: Collaboration features include comments, folders, and keyword alerts
quote: Collaboration using comments, folders, keyword alerts, + more

text: Users can choose bot-free (beta) or traditional bot-based meeting capture
quote: Choice of bot-free (in beta) or bot capture

text: Keyword alerts automatically monitor meetings for key topics
quote:
Automatically monitor key topics so  
you never miss critical moments

text: Meeting data can be accessed inside ChatGPT and Claude via connectors
quote:
Your meeting data, now inside  
ChatGPT, Claude, and more

text: Public apps integrating with Fathom should be built using OAuth
quote: If you're developing a public app that you wish to integrate with Fathom, you should build it using OAuth.

text: Webhooks deliver meeting summary, transcript, and action items to a chosen URL
quote: Webhooks will send your meeting data (optionally including the summary, transcript, and action items) to a URL of your choice.

text: Official SDKs handle authentication, pagination, and error handling automatically
quote: Get started in minutes with our official SDKs. They handle authentication, pagination, error handling, and all the complex stuff so you can focus on building amazing integrations.

text: Claude CLI can add the Fathom MCP server directly
quote: claude mcp add fathom -- npx mcp-remote@latest https://api.fathom.ai/mcp

text: Summary endpoint can return data directly or POST it asynchronously to a destination URL
quote: If you send `destination_url`, the endpoint will behave in an asynchronous manner. If you do not send `destination_url`, the endpoint will return the data directly.

text: API can fetch a call's summary directly or via destination URL callback
quote: Get summary ... Either the destination URL for where we'll POST the call summary, or the summary for the recording.

text: AI automatically generates action items from meetings
quote: AI generated action items

text: Built-in conversational meeting assistant answers questions about calls
quote: Conversational meeting assistant

text: Users can create clips, playlists, and search across all calls
quote: Clips, playlists + search across calls

text: Webhook payloads include a signature to verify they came from Fathom
quote: Webhook verification helps ensure that incoming requests to your endpoint are from Fathom and haven't been altered.

text: Claude Code can add Fathom's MCP server directly from the command line
quote: Claude Code supports adding MCP servers directly from the command line.

text: Fathom can be connected to any MCP-compatible tool via its server URL and authentication
quote: Connect Fathom to any MCP-compatible tool using the server URL below, then authenticate to access your meeting data.

text: Admins can view all users' shared meetings via configurable view permissions
quote: Admins can access all users' shared meetings by configuring View permissions

text: Notes can be captured with or without a bot joining the call
quote: Capture notes your way – bot or no bot – so you can stay focused on the meeting

text: AI-generated summaries are available immediately after each call
quote:
AI summaries instantly  
available after your call

text: Custom meeting bot can be configured for capture
quote: Custom meeting bot

text: SSO and SCIM provisioning are supported for enterprise identity management
quote: SSO & SCIM provisioning

text: Webhook creation requires selecting at least one content type (transcript, CRM matches, summary, action items)
quote: Create a webhook to receive new meeting content. At least one of `include_transcript`, `include_crm_matches`, `include_summary`, or `include_action_items` must be true.

text: Advanced call summaries support custom summary formats
quote: Advanced call summaries, including custom summaries

text: Unlimited recordings and transcriptions are offered
quote: Unlimited recordings + transcriptions
